author: /root/sizing_locales_c
review_scope: Independent full-text reading of all 31 leaf elements, detailed comparison of all 22 changed leaf elements carrying the 19 English semantic replacements, plus independently recomputed static checks. Candidate author did not perform this review.
semantic_assessment: Read all candidate text. Body/garment measurements, flat width/circumference, and the same-method prerequisite for comparing an existing garment are explicit. Women-specific gender inflection fits the section. The child, layering, chart-limitation, contact and cart checks preserve the source, including the conditional nature of separate item selections.
language_assessment: New Hebrew passages are readable and coherent, with consistent sizing terminology and clear instructions. No added fit, age-range, material, stretch or fulfilment claim was found.

findings.description: The unchanged intro literally says to purchase one person at a time (ולרכוש אדם אחד), and unchanged child labels retain a transliterated toddler term. Context signals shopping for each wearer; this inherited wording was not introduced by the candidate and broader polishing is outside scope.

competence.basis: Independent model-based bilingual editorial assessment of the complete supplied text, not inferred from structural tests.
competence.bounded_assessment: Sufficient confidence for this everyday apparel sizing guidance; no unresolved meaning ambiguity or new grammatical error requiring a hold was found.

limits: No native-speaker or human certification is claimed.
This review approves the exact textual candidate and bounded markup only; root retains publication authority.
Actual localized destination arrivals, public rendering, mobile layout and computed RTL behavior were NOT RUN by this reviewer; root must verify them.
Existing unchanged localized copy was checked for preservation and noted where awkward; this is not a broad quality certification of the entire storefront.
Review is invalid if source or candidate hashes change.
